name: SUPRA Builder Guard
description: Enforcement mechanism guaranteeing that only SUPRA-Builder performs file mutations.

rules.rule: No read-only agent may directly edit, write, create, or delete any file
All mutation requests from read-only agents must pass through the Mission Center write request protocol
rules.enforcement: Validate request origin before routing to Builder
rules.violation_response: reject + 'Use Mission Center write request protocol'

rules.rule: SUPRA-Builder may only write files that have been validated by the Mission Center pipeline
rules.enforcement: Check validation stamp before applying mutation

rules.rule: SUPRA-Builder must report all mutations to Mission Center for audit trail
rules.enforcement: Mutation log must be written to mission_center history

steps: 1. Read-only agent identifies need for file mutation
2. Agent prepares: { target_file, mutation_type, content_diff, rationale }
3. Agent submits write request to Mission Center queue
4. Mission Center validates: is requestor read-only? yes → proceed
6. Builder picks up request, reviews, and applies mutation
8. Builder reports back to requesting agent
